cohort_total_n_excerpt: A prospective cohort study was performed with 41,837 participants in South Korea.
reason: The prospective cohort identifies incident prostate cancer without separating aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal disease.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In contrast, first-degree family history of PCa, alcohol consumption, age, and income were valuable for PCa prediction.
estimate_classifications.reason: The abstract establishes analysis of alcohol in relation to incident prostate cancer generally. It provides no aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.
